children.name: Calectasia
children.description: Calectasia — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Calectasia browneana Keighery, K.W.Dixon & R.L.Barrett
children.description: Calectasia browneana, commonly known as blue tinsel lily, is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as a spreading, perennial, tufted herb.

children.name: Calectasia cyanea R.Br.
children.description: Calectasia cyanea, commonly known as the star of Bethlehem or blue tinsel lily, is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as a perennial herb and is endemic to the south–west of Western Australia.

children.name: Calectasia demarzii R.L.Barrett
children.description: Calectasia demarzii R.L.Barrett — a liliopsida species in the genus Calectasia.

children.name: Calectasia elegans R.L.Barrett
children.description: Calectasia elegans, the elegant tinsel lily, is a species of flowering plants in the family Dasypogonaceae.

children.name: Calectasia gracilis Keighery
children.description: Calectasia gracilis, commonly known as blue tinsel lily, is a species of plant in the family Dasypogonaceae and is endemic to the south-west of Western Australia.

children.name: Calectasia grandiflora Preiss
children.description: Calectasia grandiflora, commonly known as the blue tinsel lily, is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as a perennial herb endemic to the south-west of Western Australia.

children.name: Calectasia hispida R.L.Barrett & K.W.Dixon
children.description: Calectasia hispida, commonly known as blue tinsel lily or hispid tinsel lily, is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as a rhizomatous, erect, clumping perennial herb.

children.name: Calectasia intermedia Sond.
children.description: Calectasia intermedia, commonly known as blue tinsel-lily or eastern tinsel lily is a species of flowering plant in the family Dasypogonaceae, endemic to the border areas of western Victoria and south-eastern South Australia and flowering in early spring.

children.name: Calectasia jubilaea R.L.Barrett
children.description: Calectasia jubilaea R.L.Barrett — a liliopsida species in the genus Calectasia.

children.name: Calectasia keigheryi R.L.Barrett & K.W.Dixon
children.description: Calectasia keigheryi, commonly known as blue tinsel lily, is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as an erect, rhizomatous, perennial herb.

children.name: Calectasia narragara R.L.Barrett & K.W.Dixon
children.description: Calectasia narragara, commonly known as a blue tinsel lily or star of Bethlehem, is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as a tufted rhizomatous herb.

children.name: Calectasia obtusa R.L.Barrett & K.W.Dixon
children.description: Calectasia obtusa, commonly known as a blue tinsel lily or blunt-leaved tinsel lily is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as an erect, small shrub with stems to 50 cm.

children.name: Calectasia palustris R.L.Barrett & K.W.Dixon
children.description: Calectasia palustris, commonly known as a blue tinsel lily or swamp tinsel lily is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as a perennial, tufted herb with stilt roots.

children.name: Calectasia pignattiana K.W.Dixon & R.L.Barrett
children.description: Calectasia pignattiana, commonly known as the stilted tinsel lily or Pignatti's star of Bethlehem, is a plant in the family Dasypogonaceae growing as a perennial herb and is endemic to the south–west of Western Australia.

children.name: Calectasia valida R.L.Barrett
children.description: Calectasia valida R.L.Barrett — a liliopsida species in the genus Calectasia.

children.name: Baxteria
children.description: Baxteria — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Baxteria australis R.Br. ex Hook.
children.description: Baxteria is a genus of flowering plant in the Dasypogonaceae described as a genus in 1843. There is only one known species, Baxteria australis,  found only in the southwestern part of Western Australia.

children.name: Kingia
children.description: Kingia — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Kingia australis R.Br.
children.description: Kingia is a genus consisting of a single species, Kingia australis, and belongs to the plant family Dasypogonaceae. The Aboriginal name bullanock is used as a common name for the plant.

children.name: Dasypogon
children.description: Dasypogon — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Dasypogon bromeliifolius R.Br.
children.description: Dasypogon bromeliifolius, commonly known as pineapple bush, is a species of shrub in the family Dasypogonaceae native to Western Australia.

children.name: Dasypogon hookeri J.Drumm.
children.description: Dasypogon hookeri, commonly known as pineapple bush, is a species of shrub in the family Dasypogonaceae native to Western Australia.

children.name: Dasypogon obliquifolius Lehm. ex Nees
children.description: Dasypogon obliquifolius is a species of shrub in the family Dasypogonaceae native to Western Australia.
